newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northwest spot oil products notionally flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northwest spot oil products notionally flat.

text.p: Spot oil product prices in the U.S. Northwest stayed notionally flat Friday, in line with faint activity in California.
Conventional grade California gasoline idled at 62.50/63.25 cents a gallon on Friday, with most traders gone for an industry conference.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline stayed notionally unchanged at 61/62 cents.
Seattle low sulphur diesel remained at 75/76 cents and jet fuel remained at 75/76 cents.
